extracted.intended_audience: intellectual property practitioners, law firm managers, and researchers using AIPLA economic survey data
extracted.subtask_description: Extraction of survey metrics from the AIPLA Report of the Economic Survey 2023 covering income, billing, hours, work allocation, and demographic breakdowns for IP practitioners (solo, partner, partner-track, etc.).

rubrics_metrics.name: Total Gross Income for 2022 from your primary practice - Full-time Only (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in calendar year 2022 from primary practice (reported with first quartile (25%), median, mean (average), third quartile (75%)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown for respondent groups (e.g., Private Firm Equity Partner, Partner-Track Attorney, Solo Practitioner) and broken down by Years of IP Law experience, Location (CMSA/regions), IP Technical Specialization (>=50%), Age, Gender, Highest Non-Law Degree, Ethnicity, Full-time IP lawyers/agents in firm (size buckets). Values reported: 25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile, and number of individuals.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total gross income for 2022 by Type of work - Full-time Only (Q13a)
rubrics_metrics.description: Total gross income in 2022 reported separately for types of work (>=50%): IP prosecution work vs IP litigation (with 25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile and number of individuals).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Enables comparison of income for practitioners whose primary work is IP prosecution vs IP litigation; reported with same summary statistics and sample counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Amount of year-end cash bonus (Q13b)
rubrics_metrics.description: Amount of year-end cash bonus for 2022 (first quartile 25%, median, mean (average), third quartile 75%).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported for respondent groups and broken down by Years of IP Law experience, Location, IP Technical Specialization, Age, Gender, Highest Non-Law Degree, Ethnicity, firm size. Shows distributional statistics (25%, median, mean, 75%) and sample counts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Employer's 2022 contribution to all of your 401(k)/403(b) retirement and savings plans (Q14)
rubrics_metrics.description: Employer contribution amounts to 401(k)/403(b) retirement/savings plans in 2022 (25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Displayed for respondent groups with breakdowns by experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size. Includes notes where ISD (insufficient data) appears.

rubrics_metrics.name: Expected total cash income for 2023 - Full-time Only (Q15)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent expectation of total cash income for 2023 (25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported across respondent segments and broken down by the same demographic and practice variables as other income measures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to the following types of work (Q18)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of professional time devoted to listed work types (reported as mean (average) percentages and by income level buckets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work types include: IP prosecution work; Opinions or counseling prior to litigation or formal ADR; IP licensing; Non-licensing transactional work; IP litigation; Post-grant proceedings; Other dispute resolution; Supervision and training of other attorneys or agents within your organization; Office management and administration; Marketing/Business Development; Participation in bar/professional association activities; Managing outside counsel for IP prosecution work; Managing outside counsel for IP litigation work; Non-IP legal; Pro bono work; Other. Values shown as mean percentages and broken out by Gross Income in 2022 bands.

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of time devoted to the following IP areas (Q16)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of time devoted to specific IP areas (reported as mean (average) percentages and by income level buckets).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: IP areas listed: Business Law; Copyrights; Foreign IP Law; General IP; Patents; Trade Secrets; Trademarks; Privacy/Cybersecurity; Other areas. Reported with sample counts and mean percentages across income bands.

rubrics_metrics.name: New priority US and PCT Patent application prepared and filed by you in 2022 (Q20)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number (or percent/time) of new priority US and PCT patent applications prepared and filed by respondent in 2022 (reported as mean, median, quartiles).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Statistics shown: mean (average), median (midpoint), first and third quartiles; breakdowns include Location, IP Technical Specialization, firm size, Years of experience, Age, etc. Some cells show ISD where data insufficient.

rubrics_metrics.name: Billable hours recorded in 2022 (Q32)
rubrics_metrics.description: Reported number of billable hours recorded by respondent in 2022 (25th percentile, median, mean (average), 75th percentile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Presented by respondent group and stratified by Years of IP Law experience, Location, IP specialization, Age, Gender, Highest Non-Law Degree, Ethnicity, firm size buckets. Includes first and third quartile, median, mean, and number of respondents.

rubrics_metrics.name: Average hourly billing rate in 2022 (Q33)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent's average hourly billing rate in 2022 (25th percentile, median, mean (average), 75th percentile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Shown across respondent groups and broken out by experience, geography, technical specialization, age, gender, education, ethnicity, firm size. Some cells marked ISD (insufficient data).

rubrics_metrics.name: Percent of services in 2022 that were billed (or will be billed) by type of basis (Q31)
rubrics_metrics.description: Percent of services billed (or to be billed) by billing basis in 2022, reported as mean (average) percentages for each basis type.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Billing basis categories: Hourly Billing, Predetermined Fee, Contingent Fee, Other Basis. Values are mean percentage of services billed by each basis and are reported for respondent groups and demographic/practice breakouts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022 (Q30)
rubrics_metrics.description: Dollar amount billed for legal services performed in 2022 reported by respondent (25th percentile, median, mean, 75th percentile).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provided for respondent groups with stratifications (experience, location, specialization, age, gender, degree, ethnicity, firm size). Includes first/third quartiles, median, mean, and sample size; also sometimes alternative summary rows (e.g., additional percentiles or ISD markers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Types of work (>=50%)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator of the respondent's primary type of work when >=50% of time is devoted to that work (e.g., IP prosecution work, IP litigation).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to stratify income and other measures (see Q13a by Type of work). Sample counts reported for those whose primary work meets >=50% threshold.

rubrics_metrics.name: Full-time Intellectual Property lawyers and agents in the firm or corporation (firm size buckets)
rubrics_metrics.description: Firm size represented by number of full-time IP lawyers and agents in the firm or corporation (categories: 1-2, 3-5, 6-10, 11-25, 26-50, 51-100, 101-150, More than 150).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Firm size is a stratification variable used throughout the tables to report income, billing, hours, and other metrics; counts per bucket provided.

rubrics_metrics.name: Background/demographic variables (survey background information)
rubrics_metrics.description: Respondent background fields including: Admitted to the Patent Bar (Yes/No); Age; Gender; Ethnicity; IP non-attorney experience (mean years); IP attorney experience (mean years); Highest education other than law (None, Bachelor's, Master's, Doctorate, Other).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These fields are reported as counts, percentages, and mean years where applicable and are used to stratify all primary economic metrics in the report.
